result.brief: 提出结构化动力学图世界模型 SD-GWM，将自动力学、图耦合动力学与有界残差分离建模，实现约束保持的可审计长时序 rollout 与反事实故障定位。
result.reason: Graph world model with constrained rollout, residual learning, and interpretable calibration; matches world-model direction on dynamics modeling and planning-style rollout, though domain is hydrology not video.
